questions.prompt: Do the store screenshots match what the app really shows?
questions.hint: Open the app and compare it with the pictures on the left.

questions.prompt: How clearly does the app explain what it does in the first minute?
How well does the app run and look?
questions.hint: Think about speed, crashes, readability and design.

questions.prompt: Quality check: please select “Somewhat” for this question.
questions.hint: We use a few of these to catch rushed answers.

questions.prompt: Did the app ask you for money, a deposit or a “registration fee” before showing you anything useful?
Did it promise guaranteed profit, guaranteed loan approval or very high returns?
Which of these did the app ask for?
questions.hint: Choose all that apply. Only choose what you actually saw.
options: Access to contacts, photos or files

questions.prompt: Did you notice any of these warning signs?
options: Fake countdown timers or pressure to hurry
Store reviews look copied or repeated
Developer name does not match the company shown in the app
Mentions of harassment or threats over repayments

questions.hint: Check the developer name, website, privacy policy and support email.

questions.prompt: In your own words, what does this app do and who is it for?
questions.hint: At least 25 words. Don't copy the store description.

questions.prompt: What's the best and the worst thing about it? Give one real example of each.
questions.hint: At least 20 words. Say what you did, and what happened.

options: I would install and recommend it
I would install it with caution
I suspect this app is a scam

questions.confirmation_label: I used this app myself, and these answers are my own honest opinion.
